return</a> that left 1 second on the clock.\n\n\r\n              The Eagles had taken a 17-16 lead on <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3050478/jake-elliott\">Jake Elliott</a>'s 48-yard after <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3928931/ross-matiscik\">Ross Matiscik</a> left the game with an injury.\n\n\r\n              Philadelphia, which slipped to 2/3 for the first time since 2021, played without leading rusher <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3929630/saquon-barkley\">Saquon Barkley</a> and receiver <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4241478/devonta-smith\">DeVonta Smith</a> and with a makeshift offensive line. The Eagles rushed for just 22 yards.\n\n\r\n              <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4360310/trevor-lawrence\">Trevor Lawrence</a> completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards and two touchdowns — both to Washington — along with an interception for the Jaguars (4-1).\n\n\r\n              “One of the craziest games, maybe the craziest game I’ve ever been a part of,” Lawrence said, “and I’ve been in some pretty wild ones. Just how cool is this sport? The game’s never over.”\n\n\r\n              Washington, who caught a 51-yard touchdown pass in the first quarter, had six receptions for 124 yards.\n\n\r\n              Eagles linebacker <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3917657/zack-baun\">Zack Baun</a> ensured his team went into halftime with a 14-7 lead by getting past <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4362619/chris-rodriguez-jr\">Chris Rodriguez Jr</a>. and <a href=\"https://x.com/Eagles/status/2109302910366707832\">tackling <a href=\"http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4882093/bhayshul-tuten\">Bhayshul Tuten</a></a> for a loss when Jacksonville went for it on fourth-and-goal from the 1 with 1 second left in the half. Eagles coach Nick Sirianni jumped and pumped his first in reaction.\n\n\r\n              Sirianni was asked about not kicking the ball out of bounds at the end.\n\n\r\n              “I didn’t make the
